items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Joe Saunders and the other boy handled all the instruments, bandstand and stuff... Joe Saunders, the road manager would take the things to the ballroom

ctx.x: We get dressed right in the bus travelling. The bus get there, we just put on the ties and (inaudible).
They had two -- Joe Saunders and the other boy handled all the instruments, bandstand and stuff.
